programme.desc: On April 13, 2025, Russian forces launched an Iskander missile strike on the center of the city of Sumy. The attack killed 35 people and injured another 127. In terms of civilian casualties, it was the deadliest attack on the city throughout Russia's war against Ukraine. That day, Viktoriia Rudyka was walking through the city with her daughters, Kira and Elina. The missile exploded just a few meters away from them. Despite a long period of medical treatment and the loss of her husband in the war, the family remained in Sumy. The girls practice ballet, which has become a form of rehabilitation for them. Their small scooters, shattered by shrapnel and stained with blood, have since become a symbol of the tragedy. Thirteen-year-old Kyrylo Iliashenko, who was also wounded that day, managed to open the door of a burning bus and saved the lives of many people. Just one month after the tragedy, he won a silver medal in beach wrestling at the European Championship. Kyrylo continues to train and dreams of one day competing in the Olympic Games.

programme.desc: Saccadic Eye Masking. Saccadic eye movements are characterized as the fast movement of eyes when perceiving motion. These are so fast that they are blurred.
